system.description:
Sturdy folk of shell and claw with a strong sense of duty. Rarely seen away from their lagoon homes, but always considered valuable allies.

Vice Grip

(1/encounter) When you hit a creature in melee, you may grapple it for free. Requires a free claw. [M]

+1 Defense. [A]
